elements.name: Cancel removal of a model-state parameter column

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user adds d0 to the model-state table and sets Copy State d0 to 2 in while leaving the other members at 1 in
